_comment: Eco photo verification data. Read by the Python verifier (ecoverify/) and later by the game server for skins.
_detections_comment: COCO class -> taxonomy item. kind 'streak' = everyday recyclable (counts toward the daily CO2 cap); kind 'depot' = drop-off item (counts once per physical item, at most depot_max_per_day per day, not capped). CO2 always comes from the taxonomy item.

bottle.item: Plastic bottles, jugs, and tubs (#1 PET, #2 HDPE, #5 PP)

wine glass.item: Window panes, mirrors, drinking glasses, and ceramics

vase.item: Window panes, mirrors, drinking glasses, and ceramics

_subtypes_comment: Second stage: CLIP picks one label for the crop, only among these. reject_message = not waste (e.g. a reusable mug).

Corrugated cardboard (shipping boxes).disposal: Flatten boxes, remove packing tape, keep dry in blue bin.

Paperboard (cereal & shoe boxes, cores).disposal: Flatten cereal/shoe boxes; recycle empty toilet paper/towel cores.

Office paper.disposal: Clean dry white/colored paper. Shredded paper in paper bag.

Newspapers.disposal: Keep dry and unbundled with plastic twine.

Magazines and catalogs.disposal: Glossy magazines and flyers are 100% recyclable.

Junk mail and envelopes.disposal: Paper envelopes (windows are acceptable in modern pulpers).

Paperback books.disposal: Donate if readable, or recycle paperback covers and pages.

Milk, juice, and soup cartons.disposal: Rinse empty carton, recap, place in cartons/paper bin.

Aluminum drink cans.disposal: Rinse, do not crush completely if automated sorting is used. 95% energy saved vs virgin bauxite!

Steel and tin food cans.disposal: Rinse clean, tuck lid inside can to protect recycling workers.

Clean aerosol cans.disposal: Ensure completely empty; remove plastic nozzle cap.

Clean aluminum foil and food trays.disposal: Ball foil up to at least 5cm diameter; rinse food trays.

Copper wiring.disposal: Scrap metal depot or specialty drop-off. High value recycling.

Steel parts and scrap metal.disposal: Local recycling center scrap metal container.

Clear, green, and brown glass beverage b.disposal: Rinse, remove corks/caps (metal caps go to metal bin).

Glass food jars.disposal: Rinse pasta/jam jars thoroughly; infinitely recyclable!

Window panes, mirrors, drinking glasses,.disposal: Specialty drop-off / ecocenter only (different melting point than container glass).

Plastic bottles, jugs, and tubs (#1 PET,.disposal: Empty liquids, leave cap screwed on, place in yellow bin.

Plastic bags and shrink wrap.disposal: Store drop-off / specialty film collection (do NOT put in standard sorting conveyor).

Expanded polystyrene / Styrofoam (#6).disposal: Clean packaging blocks only at dedicated EPS depot.

Computers and laptops.disposal: E-waste collection point. Recovers gold, copper, rare earth metals.

Mobile phones.disposal: Certified phone recycler or trade-in. High environmental value!

TVs and monitors.disposal: E-waste drop-off center. Safe extraction of polarizing films & circuitry.

Printers.disposal: Electronics recycling depot; remove ink/toner cartridges separately.

Cables and chargers.disposal: Cable collection bin at electronics store or ecocenter.

Small household appliances.disposal: Toasters, kettles, hair dryers go to small appliance e-bins.

Household batteries (AA/AAA/9V).disposal: Supermarket battery collection box. Never in household trash!

Rechargeable batteries (Li-ion/NiMH).disposal: Specialty battery depot; tape terminals of lithium batteries.

LED and CFL light bulbs.disposal: Hardware store drop-off box. CFLs contain mercury and must not break.

Food scraps.disposal: Fruit/vegetable peels, plate scrapings into home compost or brown bin. Reduces methane!

Coffee grounds.disposal: Direct to compost or soil fertilizer (rich in nitrogen).

Yard trimmings.disposal: Green waste bin or municipal composting facility.

Wood waste.disposal: Untreated wood to timber recycling / biomass mulch.

Clothing.disposal: Textile donation bin (Friperie) or fabric shredding recycling.

Shoes.disposal: Shoe donation container or specialized rubber reclaim drop-off.

Tires.disposal: Auto repair shop or tire recycling depot (shredded for athletic turf/asphalt).

Used cooking oil.disposal: Pour into sealed plastic bottle and bring to collection center for biodiesel conversion.

Used motor oil.disposal: Service station or hazardous waste facility for industrial re-refining.
